about: Reviewed false positives the SAST gate accepts. Each entry matches one tool, rule and file exactly; the alert stays visible in GitHub's Security tab. Adding an entry needs a reason and a reviewer in the pull request.

findings.reason: sha256Hex and hmacHex hash 32-byte random API keys and session tokens (identity/api-keys.ts, identity/sessions.ts), not passwords. Passwords use argon2id (identity/password.ts). A slow hash adds nothing for high-entropy random secrets.
hashApiKey hashes a random generated API key (high entropy), not a password.
classIdFor derives a stable class id from organization, year and class code; nothing secret is hashed. CodeQL follows an API-key flow through the import route into this function.
JOIN_CODE_ALPHABET has 32 characters and 256 is divisible by 32, so byte % 32 is uniform: there is no bias.
